title: Uykucu's Coins
description: Uykucus Coins introduces a vanilla-friendly coin economy with tiered currency progression and safe right-click exchanges, designed for servers and roleplay gameplay.
body:
Uykucus Coins is a lightweight Fabric mod that adds a tier-based coin economy to Minecraft while preserving a vanilla-friendly gameplay experience.

The mod introduces multiple coin tiers with clear progression, allowing players to convert coins using simple right-click and shift-right-click interactions. Higher-tier coins are created by combining lower-tier ones, while reverse conversion is always possible when sneaking.

The system is designed to be safe and reliable. If a player’s inventory is full during a conversion, any remaining items are automatically dropped on the ground instead of being deleted. This ensures consistent behavior and prevents item loss in both singleplayer and multiplayer environments.

Uykucus Coins is well-suited for economy-based servers, roleplay or medieval-themed worlds, and custom trading systems. Its clean structure also allows for easy future expansion, such as banker NPCs, exchange blocks, configurable exchange rates, or GUI-based currency conversion.

The mod focuses on simplicity, clarity, and stability rather than unnecessary complexity, making it easy to integrate into existing worlds and modpacks.
